applicabilityBasis.summary: RAAC describes pmUSD as the dollar-stable fToken in an RWA CDP silo, with tokenized gold collateral and xPM absorbing collateral volatility. Market minting/rebalancing is manager-only with RAAC-participating multisigs; full issuerlessness is not assumed. The documented PSM exchanges pmUSD for sUSDS at an internal $1 pmUSD rate, with fees and liquidity/NAV pause controls. sUSDS is a digital asset, not currency or a currency-denominated deposit under the monetary-value definition. No token-specific legal issuer obligation to redeem for fixed monetary value was substantiated. Transferable dollar-stablecoin and DeFi utility leave applicability unclear. Gold backing does not make its reference value gold, and pmUSD is distinct from the yield-accruing COD/silo share.

genius.notes: Current September 18, 2026 terms name Porta Aurea Ltd, BVI company 2218368, as interface operator. Older terms-and-conditions name Regnum Aurum Acquisition Corp. Neither proves which entity legally issues pmUSD or assumes currency redemption, so issuerEntity is omitted and no issuer transfer is inferred. USD reference is distinct from gold collateral and collateral-security characterization. The PSM is digital-asset liquidity, not verified statutory currency redemption. No token-specific public GENIUS approval, application, qualification or registered exception was found. Current terms bar US/Canada persons; access restrictions do not establish approval. Upstream collateral reserve-feed evidence is not represented as monthly pmUSD statutory reserve attestation.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of October 7, 2026, opened regulator directories, implementation publications, product disclosures and exact-name regulator searches yielded no public token-specific PPSI approval, GENIUS state qualification, official pending application, registered foreign exception or GENIUS enforcement action for RAAC pmUSD. These are bounded public checks, not proof that every nonpublic record is absent. The OCC bank-applications table and NYDFS ordinary licensing list are not complete GENIUS authorization registers. Legal issuer identity remains unresolved, so undisclosed-entity records cannot be excluded.
